text:
Priya: PR 16543 failing macos-smoke on shard 4 with a nondet image diff. Merge window at 17:00 — can someone eyeball quickly?
Devon: I'll take a look. pinging @Marta for approval if it's just a snapshot update.
ci-bot: Build job: https://ci.example/16543-PR-run failed on macos-smoke (shard 4). Test: render_snapshot_test::diff_image. Attachments: logs + failed image.
Marta: On it. Can you paste the minimal repro steps? I can kick a targeted rerun for shard4.
Priya: Short repro: `./scripts/run_smoke --shard=4 --seed=42` — sometimes passes locally. Suspect pixel tolerance / font fallback. Stack snippet: ```AssertionError: images differ by 2.3% (threshold 1%)
 at render_snapshot_test::compare_images (snapshot_test.cc:214)```
Devon: OK, let's do 3 targeted reruns spaced a few minutes. If we get 2/3 passes we can consider merging, otherwise I'll bisect later today.
Priya: Prefer not to update snapshots unless deterministic. If it's flaky, open a follow-up ticket first.
Marta: Agreed. Running targeted rerun now (shard=4, macos-smoke) x3. Will post results here.
ci-bot: Targeted rerun #1: FAIL. log: https://ci.example/rerun/1
ci-bot: Targeted rerun #2: PASS. log: https://ci.example/rerun/2
ci-bot: Targeted rerun #3: PASS. log: https://ci.example/rerun/3
Devon: 2/3 passes — looks flaky. I'm fine with merge after Marta leaves LGTM. Please add a follow-up infra ticket to investigate font metrics in the macos CI image.
Priya: Filed INF-4027 with repro, logs, and diff images. Link: https://issues.example/INF-4027. Marta, can you leave a comment/approve when you feel good?
Marta: :thumbsup: leaving LGTM now that run3 passed. Note: will follow up on INF-4027 and assign to eng-infra.
Priya: Thanks — merging in ~30m to hit merge window. I'll monitor post-merge telemetry and abort if we see regressions.
Devon: Nice. If the flake resurfaces consistently we'll revert and bisect.
Marta: Also adding a small CI job to capture font metrics on macos smoke in the follow-up ticket.
Priya: Thanks team!
